mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 50 degrees with clear skies at Verona Area High School, and we have an air quality index of 53. It is a third quarter moon, and keep an eye out for the space station passing overhead at 5:42 AM, rising near Cross Plains and moving toward Oregon about halfway up the sky.

The city wants to remind residents about winter parking regulations which begin November 20, requiring odd and even side parking between 1:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m. Also, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, and yoga classes at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Looking ahead, you can also join trivia nights at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company this coming Tuesday.
In a report from October 25, police responded to an intersection where a driver was found passed out, resulting in an O W I arrest.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, which is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM so you can grab a scoop then.
